source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to the human endocrine system (PDF 59-60).

blocks.text: Insani endocrine system un glands aur aaza ka majmooa hai jo jism ke kaam qaboo karne ke liye hormones banate aur chhorte hain. Khaaka bare glands ki jagahein dikhata hai.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ka surmayi khaaka jis mein bare endocrine glands apni jagah par hain: dimagh ke neeche pituitary, gardan mein thyroid, meda (digestive tract) ke peeche pancreas, gurdon ke oopar adrenal glands, rahim ke saath ovaries aur testes. Alag khaake: anterior aur posterior lobe wala pituitary; peeche parathyroid glands wala thyroid; gurda jis ke oopar adrenal gland hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.1: Insani jism mein bare endocrine glands ki jagahein (kitab ki Figure 16.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Kaunse endocrine glands gardan mein hain?
blocks.explanation: Thyroid aur us ki pichli sateh par chaar parathyroid glands.

items: Bare glands: hypothalamus, pituitary, pineal, thyroid, parathyroids, thymus, adrenals, pancreas, gonads.
